changes: Implemented the Story 6 Wave 3 executable pre-review gate, binding coverage basis and acceptance topology to producer, consumer, mutation, transcript, authority, source-closure, and cross-session validation identity evidence.
usage: Before advancing DEV to REVIEW, run acceptance_topology_check and pre_review_check. Progress is allowed only when current structural and executable evidence, biting mutations, and a related transcript all pass.
expectedOutcome: Missing, stale, or session-bound acceptance evidence is mechanically blocked before REVIEW, while a complete current proof chain passes without weakening legacy or rollout boundaries.
actualTranscript: The current pre_review_check reports PASS with no codes; 21 of 21 required intents are current; four Round 10 reviewer lanes passed; Claude CLI and Codex CLI recorded three rounds each; focused build and mutation tests passed.
outcomeDiff: Expected and observed outcomes match: complete evidence passes, while omission, forgery, stale bindings, transport-session drift, near-miss commands, and semantic environment mutations fail closed.
limitations: Wave 3A remains intentionally skipped under the flat rollout, and Wave 4 enforcement is outside this story.
pitfalls: Only the exact canonical live-proof command receives the extended timeout. Extra arguments, whitespace variants, environment injection, and shell composition retain the shorter default budget.
